title: Supreme Court judge appointed
content:
22 February 2006

Supreme Court judge appointed

  • David Parker
Attorney-General

Honourable Noel Crossley Anderson has been appointed a Supreme Court Judge, Attorney-General David Parker today announced.
The Hon Justice Anderson graduated from the University of Auckland. He was a partner of the firm Martelli, McKegg and Adams-Smith in Auckland. His Honour commenced practice as a barrister in 1972 and was appointed a Queen’s Counsel in 1986.
Justice Anderson was appointed a Judge of the High Court in 1987, a Judge of the Court of Appeal in 2001 and was appointed President of the Court of Appeal in 2004.
